name: proofagent
description: Keep your private data private in Claude Code: ProofAgent masks personal data before Claude sees it (real values are filled back in on your machine when a tool runs) and tells you about risks in prompts, actions and tool results.

nano_key.title: ProofAgent guardrail key
nano_key.description: From app.proofagent.ai > API keys (starts with pa_nano_)

nano_url.title: ProofAgent endpoint
nano_url.description: Leave as is unless you run ProofAgent on your own servers

key_file.title: Key file (optional)
key_file.description: Path to a file holding the key, instead of pasting it

fail_closed.title: Block when ProofAgent is unreachable
fail_closed.description: Off: continue without a check and warn

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: warn: mask and notify, never block (default). strict: also stop risky actions.

reveal_on_screen.title: Show real values on my screen
reveal_on_screen.description: Claude's replies are drawn with the real values on your screen only; Claude keeps seeing placeholders
